assumptions: NWC equals 0.10 of current-year revenue in Years 1–6; terminal NWC is zero after liquidation.
Year 1 tax loss immediately offsets other group income.
Initial NWC remains EUR 80,000 and WACC is unchanged. Price examples assume no extra machine; maximum capacity is not supplied.
Past R&D and allocated existing corporate costs are excluded.
Q1/Q2 buttons reset the original sales coefficient and annual fixed costs; main price stays EUR5.10.
Figure 2 alone links price and volume with elasticity 1; the main sales slider directly scales Q1 units at EUR5.10.
Annual fixed-cost changes are flat amounts relative to Q1 EUR 240,000; Q2 uses EUR -20,000.
All other case inputs remain fixed, including EUR 1.60 production cost per can.
Green shading shows modelled positive NPV, not a probability or guaranteed outcome.
Separate sales-only test locks price at EUR5.10 and annual fixed costs at EUR220000; 100% of Q1 means no extra Q2 uplift, not flat annual sales.

scenario_extensions.main_sales_rule: Each corresponding Q1 annual unit forecast multiplied by the sales coefficient
